# Policymaker #145, iteration 0012

Iteration 0011 closed accepted/improved: [#139](https://github.com/Kucze3205/ConnectWithLabview/issues/139) fixed the VIPB conflict record, [#140](https://github.com/Kucze3205/ConnectWithLabview/issues/140) recommended accept at d588fa9 for the sources correction, and [#141](https://github.com/Kucze3205/ConnectWithLabview/issues/141) drafted [benchmark/protocol.md](../benchmark/protocol.md). The owner accepted both changes (#142, #143).
Evaluator `--check` (quoted in #139): exit 0, no errors; tasks, oracle, split, baseline and challenges still missing. Benchmark not ready, not executed, tool quality unmeasured.

## Changes
- `policy/params.yml`: `reviewer` routing is now Claude-first (sonnet → codex → luna). Codex wrote protocol.md, and the role rules prefer a different model family for review. `review` and `evaluator-verifier` stay codex-first. Expected effect: the protocol review runs on Claude. Check: the session's `models` in the 0012 record.
- `policy/working-memory.md`: updated with the 0011 results, milestone evidence, the routing rule and the next steps.

## Orders
- `review-protocol1` (reviewer, high, 60 min/25 turns): an independent method review of protocol.md against evaluation.md, goal.md and accepted-limits.md. For each resources row, it says whether the row is concrete enough to become a `capability` request. Expected gain: a commit-bound recommendation of accept, revise or reject. Before product work, evaluation.md requires this review and then the owner's acceptance. The next Policymaker reads the recommendation from the report.
- I ordered no development work alongside the review, because it would build on a method nobody has reviewed yet. I filed no `capability` requests either: the draft says no concrete store or service has been identified, so a request now would lack the resource, least access and readiness details that accepted-limits.md requires.

No `wake`. The trigger every 1 iteration calls me again next iteration.

## What next
- On revise: order a focused benchmark revision, then a re-review. On accept: file `capability` requests for the rows the review calls concrete, and order the public development work the protocol lists (case specs, answer/citation schema, lineage analysis, native-job records).
- Still undecided: how a review recommendation becomes a milestone `reviewed` status. Ask the owner if it stays open. Don't re-read records 0000–0011; working memory summarizes them.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
